description_sq:
Apartamenti qe po paraqesim per shitje gjendet prane shkolles Mihal Grameno, ne rrugen e Elbasanit. Pallati 8 katesh qe po ndertohet eshte ne faze karabina, dhe sipas lejes se ndertimit i duhen dhe 8 muaj te perfundoje.
Apartamenti ne fjale gjendet ne katin 1 mbi dyqane dhe ka nje siperfaqe bruto 87.6 m2, nga te cilat 13.1 jane siperfaqe te perbashketa dhe pjesa e mbetur hapesire neto.
Cmimi eshte 215.000 euro, dhe mareveshja mund te realizohet me keste, ku pagesa e pare te mos jetë më e vogël se sa 70 perqind e shumes se caktuar ne kontraten e sipermarjes.

UNA64101
description_en: The apartment we are offering for sale is located near the Mihal Grameno school, on Elbasan street. The 8-story building that is being built is in the construction phase, and according to the construction permit, it will take 8 months to complete. The apartment in question is located on the 1st floor above the shops and has a gross area of ​​87.6 m2, of which 13.1 are common areas and the rest is net space. The price is 215,000 euros, and the agreement can be realized in installments, where the first payment is not less than 70 percent of the amount specified in the business contract. Reference: UNA64101
